+24 is a Python composite contract, not a Native parser/Arm limit. Preserve exact-day semantics; a new multi-day composition needs its own expected tick/date checks.

Native reflected Close itself submits the close command. The Python transport independently observes clearance, then invokes ordinary life-advance as its date-liveness proof. Boundary state must reach this nested driver call; an outer FULL-only guard misses it. At the final date, avoid requiring extra calendar movement merely to award Close liveness.

integration_constraints: Reuse qualified Native25 and actual capability checks. No new native ability, DLL swap or speed-readiness promotion follows from this review.
Use the earlier of the current ordinary policy deadline, next score month, and final goal. Do not enlarge tactical horizons or change military speed/watch/scope policies.
Ensure canonical step, Arm target, result target and validation all bind the same actual date/generation; editing only the Arm token invalidates existing receipts.
_resume_life_advance already accepts native_stop_target_date_raw for an actually armed transaction, allowing a newly observed paused progressed frame without a second resume.

For multi-day date deadlines verify actual generation/start/target, expected tick count=(target-start)/24, true native pause and zero overshoot; preserve lawful early event/native interruption handling and generation-bound cancellation.
If current date equals a monthly/terminal boundary, sample before any further resume. A missing/unknown action result must not be resubmitted to compensate.
This review supplies source and prior capability evidence only. The new Python full-family composition and actual new campaign stop/month sampling remain to be verified by their owners.
